MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"A custom widget (like this catalog's own recipes) uses this exact same slot-content pattern, not a special library-only path."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Awake has no image-loading pipeline wired in yet, so this is the fallback-only look -- a real gap, not a faked one."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Built on graphicsLayer's UiAlphaEffect, applied once at UiContext's own primitive-emission choke point -- no per-widget changes needed."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Content is freeform (any ColumnScope body), unlike the dropdown menu's fixed list of UiDropdownMenuItem rows."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Content keeps rendering (dimmed) through the exit fade instead of unmounting the frame visible flips false."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Dragging one thumb past the other clamps instead of crossing -- a small minimum gap between start and end is enforced."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Each row's thumbnail samples the same Easing.transform used to drive the moving thumb, so the shape and the motion always agree."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Header and footer are each independently optional, same as shadcnCard -- a content-only sidebar is just shadcnSidebar with neither slot filled."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Header and footer are independently optional -- a body-only card is just shadcnCard with neither slot filled."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Neither has a flex-grow concept: FillMax only resolves against the enclosing scope's own fixed axis (a column's configured width, not a row's advancing width)."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"No border/background chrome on shadcnFieldSet, matching real shadcn's CSS reset of the native <fieldset> border."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"No dismiss/action slot yet -- shadcn's own Alert doesn't have one either; that's composed alongside it by the caller."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Real usage (see StarterGameUi.kt, UiShowcaseUi.kt) gives it a fixed width; letting it stretch full-width reads wrong for a nav rail."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Retargeting mid-tween restarts the duration from the current animated value instead of snapping back to the start."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"See the Shimmer page for the other loading-state animation -- a moving highlight sweep rather than a pulse or rotation."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Skeleton has a real per-widget opacity pulse (not a static box); Spinner is a real orbiting-dots animation approximating shadcn's CSS-rotated Lucide icon."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The API stays local-coordinate based so a nested canvas composes cleanly inside cards, HUDs, and docs previews."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The Dropdown Menu And Dialog page's open-state preview demonstrates the same underlying popover anchoring shadcnSelect builds on."

MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The active tab uses ShadcnButtonVariant.Primary with its background/foreground overridden to the card color; inactive tabs stay Ghost for the real chromeless-until-hover look."

MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The caller owns the trigger widget and expanded state, same split as shadcnDropdownMenu -- shadcnPopover only owns anchored positioning, dismiss, and panel chrome."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The default runtime font now uses the true-font atlas so spacing and letterforms stop fighting the showcase."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The initials overload is sugar over the slot-based primary overload; there is no capability gap between them."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The label-string overload is sugar over this content-lambda form -- there is no capability gap between them."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"The widget preview report keeps a partially scrolled proof around so clipping and thumb math are validated without manual interaction."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"This page exists so the same widget is also documented as a reusable component, not just tested as a hidden proof surface."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Uses the base theme surface style directly; it isn't a ShadcnSurfaceVariant flavor like shadcnSurface's Card variant used to be."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"We keep an open-state widget preview for tooltip sizing and anchoring so this does not depend on hover automation."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"Works with a real keyboard on every platform: GLFW key polling on desktop, the IME on Android, UIKeyInput on iOS."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnDialog is the plain content-based dialog shadcnAlertDialog is itself composed from -- this page now shows both, not just the alert-dialog wrapper."

MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnFieldRangeSlider is the label-above/value-above layout shadcn's own range demo uses; the bare shadcnRangeSlider control has no label row of its own since two knobs have no single 'beside the knob' spot."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnFieldSet/shadcnFieldLegend are new -- a titled section wrapper and its title, one step up in weight from shadcnFieldLabel."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnKbd shares its 'measure text, draw a box, draw the label' mechanics with shadcnBadge -- just a different (sm-radius, muted) style."

MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnLabel's required/disabled states show up here in isolation -- shadcnFieldLabel (used throughout Text Input and Checkout Form) is sugar over the default-state case of the same function."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnSelect already appears composed inside the Checkout Form and the Field State Matrix preview -- this page is its own first-class home in isolation."
MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$"shadcnSwitch is real shadcn's `Switch`; shadcnToggle is our own boolean pressable control -- both exist and both get a row here."

MaxLineLength:UiShowcaseCatalog.kt$description = "A bounded drawing surface for custom shapes, gradients, text, clipping, and nested authored drawing."
